spans.s: (II)--the name of Bhairava in the किरिचक्र। Br. IV. २०. ८२.
(III)--the son of महीनेत्र; ruled for ३२ years. M. २७१. २८.

--qualifications of; old, selfless, highly learned, humble, well disciplined, truthful, etc.; he who by himself follows the rules of good conduct and thus establishes the आचार and thinks of the truth of the शास्त्र by यमस् and नियमस्। Br. II. ३२. ३०-32;
